lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Lucky Seven Diner. Same stool, same pie. The feeling is not the same.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: I did everything right. Every decision. And I'm out.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Then you had a good day. You just did not get paid for it.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Over one hand, the cards pay whoever they like. Over ten thousand, they pay whoever studied. Play for the ten thousand.
